addressed_review_findings: Premise source classification is explicit and basis constrained. Excerpt clauses allow exact cited-source premises plus exact stem facts, require at least one exact excerpt premise, and forbid printed-option inputs. Stem clauses require body premises only. Arithmetic allows exact source rule and exact stem or printed option input.
Printed option text is only a hypothetical arithmetic input and cannot serve as support evidence or source proof.

Independent semantic audit binds case/content, exact matrix and evidence catalog hashes, every exact clause/status/basis/contradiction basis/premise/evidence/provenance, and the derived whole-option status for all four options.
A whole-option false conjunction may contain a distinct truthful unresolved clause; unresolved alternatives still block a unique key unless another clause directly contradicts the whole conjunction.
Malformed top-level input, matrix rows/clauses, option text, evidence catalog entries and whole-option decisions fail closed without throwing.

Whitespace-only normalization preserves every non-whitespace code point and word order, with Unicode word boundaries to prevent substring matches inside larger words; numbers, punctuation, ellipses, omissions and negation changes remain non-matching.
Exact selected source identity hashes, locators, quotes and support spans remain bound; V2 is not imported by the frozen runtime or publication path.
tested_counterexamples: Case 073 OpenAI: excerpt-basis clause combines exact stem facts and exact source rule and structurally binds.
Case 073 Gemini: paraphrased source premise remains unbound.
Case 3546 OpenAI/Luna: line-wrap-only excerpt variation binds; Gemini ellipsis/omission does not.
Synthetic arithmetic: exact option input plus exact source rule can pass with clause-bound audit.
Synthetic false conjunction: directly contradicted clause defeats rival despite separate source-silent unresolved detail.
Adversarial: wrong matrix status/provenance, missing clause audit, false number, changed negation, forged span/hash, partial option, malformed nulls, and word substring all fail.
reviewer_boundary: The audit object used in positive tests is synthetic. This proves structural binding behavior only, not reviewer independence, academic truth, or qualification success. Independent root review remains pending.
